$comment: Test cases excluded from the CI regression gate because they fail against the
current SUT as a result of a real, filed bug. They stay in the audited suites in
artifacts/test-cases/ and in the local Newman evidence under artifacts/newman/ —
this manifest only decides what the pipeline gates on.
A green pipeline therefore means 'no new regression', not 'no known bugs'.
Every entry must name a bug from BUG_REPORT.md and its GitHub issue.
build-ci-data.mjs additionally drops any remaining row that references a removed
case in precondition_note / tc_ref, because such a row can no longer run.
